chapter.heading: Mark 10

chapter.v: And he left there and wentto the region of Judea and beyond the Jordan , and crowds gathered to him again . And again , as was his custom , he taught them .
And Pharisees came up and in orderto test him asked ,“ Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife ? ”
He answered them ,“ What did Moses command you ? ”
They said ,“ Moses allowed a man to write a certificate of divorce and to send her away . ”

And Jesus said to them ,“ Because of your
hardness of heart he wrote you this commandment .
